method: Seeded candidates from sample_targets.py (seed capy-qwen37-20260925), walked in order; each accepted chunk got one natural learner question that avoids copying the chunk's wording; skips are listed with reasons. cohorts.paraphrase: English question that avoids the chunk's key terms

relevance: relevant = target + chunks of the snapshot whose normalised text is a near-copy of the target (char 5-gram Jaccard >= 0.6 or containment >= 0.8, computed by freeze_queries.py) + listed translation equivalents. Excerpt-level relevance = excerpts holding any relevant chunk. Templated look-alikes that name a different procedure (other NumWorks intervals, other pilot landing tasks) were reviewed by hand and listed under exclude before any retrieval run.
